title: The world mourns the loss of the master Ennio Morricone, honorary citizen of L'Aquila
subtitle: L'AQUILA - L'Aquila mourns the loss of Maestro Ennio Morricone, who died overnight in a Roman clinic where he was hospitalized a few days ago with a broken thigh bone. A family press release informing of the death of the great musician and composer also announces that the funeral will be strictly private in relation to the sense of humility that has always shaped every moment of his existence. He adds that his departure took place in the comfort of faith "in full clarity and great dignity" until his last breath, after greeting his beloved wife, Mary, and thanking his children and grandchildren for their love and care. that they made reservations for him. Ennio Morricone would have turned 92 on November 10th.
